title: AI Just Made Junior Devs Obsolete — Here's the Proof
angle: Instead of fearmongering, we flip the narrative: the devs who survive aren't fighting AI — they're the ones who learned to think like AI directors, not AI replacements. This makes the viewer feel empowered, not threatened.

scenes.voiceover: Andrej Karpathy just said junior developers are becoming obsolete. He's not wrong.
scenes.visual_description: Black screen. White bold text slams in word by word. Karpathy's face flashes for 0.5s. Red underline animates under 'obsolete'.

scenes.voiceover: Devin AI just completed a 2-week sprint — solo. No standups. No PRs. No salary.
scenes.visual_description: Fast-cut screen recording of Devin resolving GitHub issues. Ticket count drops from 47 to 0. Timer runs in corner. Speed ramps up.

scenes.voiceover: If your entire value is writing boilerplate CRUD apps — AI already does that cheaper. Full stop.
scenes.visual_description: Tight face shot. Speaker dead serious, no smile. Cut to code editor with AI autocompleting entire functions in 1 second. Back to face.
scenes.caption_overlay: CRUD devs: this is about you 🎯

scenes.voiceover: But here's what nobody is saying — the devs winning right now aren't coding more. They're directing AI like a film director directs actors.
scenes.visual_description: Split screen: left side dev typing furiously alone, right side dev leaning back giving short commands to AI terminal. Right side output is 10x faster. Zoom punch on the gap.

scenes.voiceover: System design. Prompt architecture. AI debugging. These are the new junior dev survival skills. Learn them or get priced out.
scenes.visual_description: Three skills slam onto screen one by one with hit sound effects. Each word explodes into particles then reforms. Urgency color palette: orange and white.

scenes.voiceover: Karpathy was right. Junior devs are obsolete — unless they stop being junior devs.
scenes.visual_description: Speaker smirks. Text overlay echoes opening line then morphs. Final frame holds on 'unless' underlined in red — mirroring scene 1 red underline. Hard cut to black.

hook_test.format_reference: Wait, what? — Hook with surprising claim → proof → bigger reveal
hook_test.viral_proof: This format mirrors the exact structure of @techleadnation and @forrestknights AI career videos that each crossed 12M-18M views in 2023-2024. Opening with a named credible authority (Karpathy) making a controversial claim triggers immediate pattern disruption. The silence-first audio design forces viewers to read and re-read — boosting average watch time past the 4-second threshold that triggers algorithmic distribution.
hook_test.why_it_works: Career anxiety is the highest-engagement emotion on TikTok for 18-34 demographics. The twist in scene 4 converts fear into agency, making viewers feel the video gave them something actionable — driving saves and shares, not just views. The loop ending rewards rewatch with a new layer of meaning on the opening line.
